pass_a_gloss: Ambrose priest fills Christ's lacks; cherubim admit through confession-fire; serpent trodden to Paradise.
pass_b_english: And not only toward not denying does this profit, Ambrose — priest bearing Christ's cross, with Protoctetus — but toward filling up what lacks of Christ's afflictions in the flesh, for his body the church. For as the cherubim with flaming sword guarding Paradise's road are passed by none unworthy, but admit the worthy through confession's fire — the denial-wood burning away — so, treading the serpent under feet, given authority 'to tread on serpents and scorpions,' (Colossians 1:24) the martyr enters Paradise, whence Adam fell, and finds the tree of life (Genesis 3:24) (Luke 10:19).
